title: 4 INTERESTING VASES
reason: Unidentified mid-century studio style vases, possibly $60 to $150 in total and more if the cone vase proves to be a named maker; check bases.
findings: Four mid-century style vases, none marked in the photos (bases not shown): white ruffled gloss glaze vase, charcoal and white speckled vase with three cut-out windows and a yellow glazed interior, tall teal and green drip glaze vase, and a conical white-ground vase with incised outline abstract fish or bird figures, dotted bodies, pink and teal lace-effect glaze and a black stippled foot. Makers cannot be identified from the photos. The cone vase and the speckled vase are the most interesting and could be named Italian, German or Australian studio or factory pieces.
condition: No chips or cracks visible in the photos; some glaze flaws at the rim of the speckled vase; bases not shown.
rescore_note: Four unmarked mid-century vases, maker unidentified and bases not shown. Decorative and common, the incised cone vase is the best, so the $30 to $80 band with upside only if a named maker. General knowledge, no web check.
